themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, gather information, and make decisions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in data collection, analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles that focus on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, highlighting key information.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI is being applied to product management tasks, including feature prioritization, market analysis, and user feedback synthesis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles detailing research into the capabilities, limitations, ethical implications, and user interactions with AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze customer data and behaviors to generate actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles directly comparing the features, performance, and effectiveness of different AI-powered research tools.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the intersection of AI with design processes, including AI's role in user research, ideation, and design system development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that assess and review the performance, usability, and value of specific AI tools for research and design.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
